rationale: The bounded, user-visible product-semantics change requires more structure than a compact path, but the supplied facts do not indicate broad runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact warranting structured_delivery.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
The change affects product semantics and is user-visible on the Pages site.
Three canonical owners and three source paths create cross-owner coordination beyond verified_change eligibility.
Four derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false, so verified_change fails closed.
compact_delivery is unavailable because the evidence does not show a completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task/
Baseline is clean and validation is deterministic, but those facts do not overcome the ownership and propagation limits.
Any impact broader than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
